documented_exceptions.reason: the repository has a single accepted collaborator; requiring a non-author approval would hard-lock main rather than strengthen it, and naming that collaborator in CODEOWNERS would record an independent-review control that does not exist
documented_exceptions.compensating_controls: seven required green contexts, enforce_admins, strict up-to-date branches, required conversation resolution, and linear history apply to every merge including the administrator's; every change is additionally reviewed on its exact head by the inline review bot and, for cross-repository contracts, by the owning sibling's seat before merge
documented_exceptions.retires_when: a second accepted reviewer identity exists; then raise required_approving_review_count to 1, add CODEOWNERS, and update this policy in the same change

documented_exceptions.value: the branch-protection policy gate is not yet self-anchored in this list
documented_exceptions.reason: the live comparison cannot authenticate anywhere in the estate: no Lotus repository holds an Actions secret carrying administration:read (measured 2026-09-06), so requiring this gate's context would block every merge on an operator action rather than assert a control. The offline document-shape check runs blocking in the repo-native unit gate today; the live comparison runs fail-closed on a schedule
documented_exceptions.compensating_controls: the offline shape check is blocking, so the table itself cannot rot; the scheduled live comparison fails closed on the absent token, so its silence is never mistaken for a pass
documented_exceptions.retires_when: an operator provisions a repository PAT with administration:read; then move the live comparison into the blocking pre-merge lane, add its context to this list and to live protection in the ordered rollout the pattern specifies, and delete this exception

stated_limitations.limitation: the comparison asserts required-check NAMES, not their source app bindings
stated_limitations.detail: branch protection also carries required_status_checks.checks[].app_id, which names the app permitted to satisfy each context. A context whose binding is removed or replaced keeps its name in contexts, so this comparison reports a match while a different app or a legacy commit status could satisfy protection.
stated_limitations.why_not_fixed_here: the checker is lifted byte-identically from the canonical implementation so that a fix propagates to every adopter; changing it in one adopter would fork an estate-wide control and silently diverge this repository from the canonical parity check. The gap is the canonical checker's, and is reported there.
stated_limitations.tracked_as: lotus-gateway#740, against the canonical implementation; this table adopts the binding declaration once the canonical checker compares it

stated_limitations.limitation: only the zero-approval exception is bound to the weakness it documents
stated_limitations.detail: validate_policy_document requires the zero-approval exception while required_approving_review_count is 0, but no invariant binds the omitted-gate-context exception to the omission. Deleting that exception while the context stays absent passes both offline validation and a matching live comparison, so the reason, compensating controls and retirement condition can be lost silently.
stated_limitations.why_not_fixed_here: the invariant lives in the canonical checker's offline validation; adding a Report-only rule would fork an estate-wide control and diverge this repository from the canonical parity check.
stated_limitations.tracked_as: lotus-gateway#743, against the canonical implementation, alongside #740 and #742
